name: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd.
about: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited, a housing finance company, engages in the housing finance business in India. The company offers loans for residential property; plot purchase and construction; home improvement and extension loans; commercial property construction and acquisition; and loans against residential properties. It serves individuals, companies, corporations, societies, and association of persons. The company was formerly known as DHFL Vysya Housing Finance Limited and changed its name to Aadhar Housing Finance Limited in August 2017. Aadhar Housing Finance Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Mumbai, India. Aadhar Housing Finance Limited is a subsidiary of Bcp Asia Ii Holdco Vii Pte. Ltd.

verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~11% a year growth, below the ~22% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 15 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 23), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 15 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 22 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2024, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 36% a year while PE moved 28 → 15.
